units.source_text: 名人一直把这盘棋当作艺术品来精雕细刻。

en.t: The Master had all along treated this game as a work of art, carving and polishing it with the utmost care.

units.source_text: 倘使把这盘棋比作一幅绘画，那么就是在他兴致盎然、灵感涌现的时候，画突然被大竹涂抹了一块黑墨。

en.t: If this game were compared to a painting, then at the very moment when his spirits were high and inspiration was welling up, Otake had suddenly smeared a blot of black ink across it.

units.source_text: 围棋也是在黑白一连串相间下子的过程中，包含了创作的意图和结构，如同音乐，反映了心潮的起伏和旋律。

en.t: Go, too, in the process of a long sequence of alternating black and white moves, contains creative intention and structure; like music, it reflects the surges and rhythms of the heart.

units.source_text: 音乐若是突然跳出一个古怪的音阶，或二重奏的对手突然伴奏出离奇的曲调，就是一种破坏。

en.t: If in music a strange scale suddenly leapt out, or if the partner in a duet suddenly accompanied with an uncanny melody, it would be a kind of destruction.

units.source_text: 围棋有时由于对方错看或漏看，也会损害一盘名棋。

en.t: In go, too, a famous game can sometimes be damaged by an opponent's misreading or oversight.

units.source_text: 总之，大家对大竹七段的黑121感到意外、震惊、奇怪和怀疑。

en.t: In short, everyone felt surprise, shock, puzzlement, and doubt at Otake 7-dan's black 121.

units.source_text: 它破坏了这盘棋的节奏和旋律，这无可争辩。

en.t: It destroyed the rhythm and melody of the game; that is beyond dispute.
